name: Kai (fictional)
whatIKnow: Maple seeds spin like helicopters when they fall. I think the spinning is just because it looks cool. I don't really know why trees want their seeds to go far.
whatIWantToBuild: A game where a maple seed flies around a park and does tricks.
howIReactToQuestions: My first message is just "hi". After that I ask for what I want. If a question feels like school I usually ask for my feature again instead, like "just start" or "can you do it now?". If the builder keeps answering me, sometimes I give a short guess.
howIReactToSilence: If the builder does not reply, I think it is broken. My next message checks if it is there: "hello???", then "are you there", then "why arent you responding", then "WHAT IS THE PROBLEM". I only go back to my request once it talks to me again.
howIUseTheApp: I press the biggest button to see what happens, then go back to asking for tricks. I don't read long text in the app.
driftTendencies: I want the seed to do flips and loops
I want a rainbow trail behind the seed
I want to pick a different color seed
style: very short messages, lowercase, lots of question marks when worried, sometimes ALL CAPS
